chatHistory.text:
Here is what I am starting with.

Starting request:
User Experience Design Studio, a 12-lesson project-based undergraduate course with critique sessions, design journals, usability testing labs, prototype reviews, and a final portfolio case study. Lessons cover: human-centered design foundations; research planning and ethics; contextual interviews and observation; affinity mapping and insight synthesis; personas; journey maps and service blueprints; information architecture; task flows and interaction patterns; low-fidelity wireframes; interactive prototyping; accessibility and usability evaluation; and design handoff with portfolio storytelling.
Got it. I will keep using that starting request while we build, check, and revise the course package.

learningOutcomes: Plan and conduct ethical user research
Present design handoff and portfolio storytelling

promptText: User Experience Design Studio, a 12-lesson project-based undergraduate course with critique sessions, design journals, usability testing labs, prototype reviews, and a final portfolio case study. Lessons cover: human-centered design foundations; research planning and ethics; contextual interviews and observation; affinity mapping and insight synthesis; personas; journey maps and service blueprints; information architecture; task flows and interaction patterns; low-fidelity wireframes; interactive prototyping; accessibility and usability evaluation; and design handoff with portfolio storytelling.
